{c_important}Abodian{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_0}*100|+%|]{/c} increased Cast Speed and {c_number}[{SF_3}*100|x%|]{/c} Movement Speed and cleaves on its attacks.

{c_important}Abodian{/c} erupts {c_important}{u}Brimstones{/u}{/c} during {c_important}Command Abodian{/c}, launching them periodically while moving and {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} when dismounting. Each {c_important}{u}Brimstone{/u}{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_BRIMSTONE}{/c} damage.
